title: Fill by voice
placeholder: Press “Speak” and dictate, or type here
unsupported: This browser cannot recognise speech. Open it in Chrome or Edge, or type the text.

speechError.denied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in the browser settings.
speechError.network: Speech recognition failed: check the internet connection.

error.failed: Could not read the dictation. Try again or fill the form by hand.
error.limit: The clinic's monthly voice limit is used up.

privacy: The text is sent to an AI and not stored. AI can make mistakes: check the fields, then save.

hint.patient: Say: the patient's full name, phone, date of birth, address and complaint.
hint.procedure: Say: the patient (if needed), the treatments done and tooth numbers, a note.
hint.prescription: Say: each medicine, how many per intake, times a day, how many days, before or after food.

result.filled: The form is filled. Check it, then save.
result.empty: Nothing in the dictation fits this form.
result.unmatched: Not found in the price list, add by hand: {{items}}
result.patientNotFound: No patient “{{name}}” found. Choose the patient by hand.

notConfigured.title: Voice input is not set up yet
notConfigured.body: The server has no AI key (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). The clinic owner needs to add it to the backend .env and restart the server.
